messages:
taylor: FYI support reported confusing ownership swaps during short traffic spikes. Customers see project owner change -> alert -> bill mismatch. We need both smoother routing and clearer console story.

samir: yep. Two separate problems: routing flip-flop causing alerts, and opaque logs so support can't quickly explain who was billed.

kevin: proposal: split the decisions: serving_affinity (who gets perf) vs billing_affinity (who gets debited). Serving can be aggressive; billing only flips after a commit window.

taylor: concrete: serve_preference_ttl=10s, billing_commit_window=45s, billing_cooldown=3600s. During commit window mark events as `billing:pending`. If commit->convert shadow ledger to project, else revert to org.

lia: console UX: add "Billing state" badge on Key detail with states (org|pending->project|project). Hover text explains timing and how to pin. Also a compact transition timeline: one line per key with events.

samir: telemetry: add span tags `routing.serving_owner`, `billing.state`, `billing.shadow_bytes`, `billing.decide_reason`. Make `billing.decide_reason` plain text like "sustained"|"manual"|"anomaly" for easy search.

kevin: sampling: traces always include routing.* tags; logs include a 0.5% indexed sample with the full history. Also emit metrics: `billing.pending_count`, `billing.commits_total`, `billing.reverts_total`, `billing.avg_pending_seconds`.

taylor: API: POST /keys/:id/billing-override {target: "org"|"project:foo", ttl_sec, reason}. Admin-only, returns previous policy and creates audit entry. Also expose GET /keys/:id/transitions for recent timeline.

lia: support wants a console filter `billing:pending` and a read-only canary view for keys in the rollout. Add that to the design.

samir: quota handling: while pending, route to project but charge org and increment a shadow counter for project. On commit, move shadow to project ledger atomically. On revert, discard shadow. Ledger events must be exported for billing reconciliation.

kevin: safety knobs: cap consecutive commits per key (default 3/24h), require higher sustain factor after revert (e.g., 2x sustained threshold), and leaky decay for shadow tokens to avoid accumulation from repeated short bursts.

taylor: rollout plan: feature-flag behind `affinity_smoothing`; canary 2% for 72h, monitor metrics and support tickets, 10% for a week, then broad. Provide a kill-switch in console.

lia: QA & testing: synthetic generator to run bursts (10s,30s,90s) at various RPS to validate pending vs commit behavior. Also billing dry-run report to compare billed vs expected during canary.

samir: docs: short RFC + runbook. Include sample log lines, example queries (`billing.state:pending`), data definitions for metrics, and a migration note for downstream billing exports.

ops-bot: Feature flag `affinity_smoothing` enabled in staging at 1735001250 :white_check_mark:

kevin: found a minor TTL unit mismatch in staging (ms vs s) when I ran the synthetic 30s burst; pushing patch now.

taylor: thanks. also add a human-readable `transition_reason` in both trace and log so support can grep easily.

lia: final default config to include in RFC: serve_ttl_s=10, billing_commit_s=45, sustain_threshold_rps=15, cooldown_s=3600, max_consecutive_commits=3, telemetry_sample_pct=0.5.

kevin: will open RFC and link here with dashboards/alert queries. After canary we'll run the billing reconciliation job and surface discrepancies to finance.

taylor: great. thanks team. This should reduce noisy alerts and give support a clear trail. :thumbsup:
